comparison_to_v75.interpretation: Causal alignment did not improve held-out teacher-forced conditional prediction despite its small autonomous paired gain.

decision: Held-out action accuracy is far below the locked 95% exposure-bias threshold, while the 22.68-point train-to-development gap exceeds the 10-point conditional-generalization threshold. On-policy recovery is not the dominant next branch. The current 7,000-record acquisition distribution does not provide sufficient conditional coverage for this 14.6M-parameter host topology.
next_authorized_work: A separately preregistered no-training acquisition-coverage audit may quantify held-out structural novelty and define a source-disjoint teacher-query expansion. No V94 tuning or rerun is authorized.
